members.name: items
members.doc: The swatches as data: color strings, or items whose `color` or `value` is a valid CSS color string. Each item needs a distinct color, because options are keyed by color, and duplicate colors throw a TypeError. An item's `label` or `textValue` names its swatch; otherwise the swatch uses its color name.

members.name: value
members.doc: The selected color, when the caller controls it. `null` is controlled and empty; `undefined` leaves the value uncontrolled.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The color selected at first, when the picker controls itself.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the picker and every swatch. A disabled enclosing ColorPicker disables it too.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the picker read-only: arrow keys still move focus between swatches, but presses, Space, and Enter do not select one. A read-only enclosing ColorPicker does the same.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the selected swatch's color as a CSS string in that swatch's color space: rgba(r, g, b, a) for a hex or RGB swatch, and hsla(h, s%, l%, a) for an HSL or HSB swatch. A disabled or read-only picker does not call it.
